patch.description: Updates the fields listed in `update_mask`; other fields are unchanged. Changing `family.raw` or `family.preset` creates a new configuration family version only when the content changes. Send group field values directly in the request body. To activate the latest family, send `{"family":{"active":true}}` with `update_mask=family.active`. The response contains the latest family. An archived group returns 404.

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to update: name, description, tags, priorityOrder, family.description, family.active, family.raw, family.preset, or one field inside family.raw or family.preset, such as family.raw.metadata or family.preset.chartVersion. family.raw and family.preset replace the whole family content; a field inside them changes only that field and keeps the others. A listed field that is omitted from the body is cleared (description, tags, family.description, and optional fields inside family.raw or family.preset) or reset to its default (priorityOrder 0, family.active false). name cannot be cleared, and family.raw.remoteConfigurations cannot be empty. Changing family.preset.chartVersion without family.preset.integrationVersion uses the default integration version of the new chart version. The body must include the arm being changed, and only the arm matching the current family's content type is accepted (raw and preset families cannot be switched). A bare family, unknown paths, and * return 400.
parameters.name: update_mask

schema.description: Comma-separated fields to update: name, description, tags, priorityOrder, family.description, family.active, family.raw, family.preset, or one field inside family.raw or family.preset, such as family.raw.metadata or family.preset.chartVersion. family.raw and family.preset replace the whole family content; a field inside them changes only that field and keeps the others. A listed field that is omitted from the body is cleared (description, tags, family.description, and optional fields inside family.raw or family.preset) or reset to its default (priorityOrder 0, family.active false). name cannot be cleared, and family.raw.remoteConfigurations cannot be empty. Changing family.preset.chartVersion without family.preset.integrationVersion uses the default integration version of the new chart version. The body must include the arm being changed, and only the arm matching the current family's content type is accepted (raw and preset families cannot be switched). A bare family, unknown paths, and * return 400.
Configuration group field values for an update. Only fields listed in update_mask are applied.
